Fujifilm X-M5

APS-C · approximately 1.5× crop · no IBIS. Native ISO 160–12800. Mechanical shutter to 1/4000 s, electronic to 1/32000 s; M timed exposures to 15 minutes. Normal flash sync 1/180 s. Recommendations assume DR100 and D Range Priority Off.

Variable zoom apertures

Wide and tele endpoints are verified. Exact intermediate transitions are not published in the inspected specifications. Between endpoints, the app uses the tele aperture as a conservative usable limit and flags it; the lens may open wider. This is not a verified intermediate maximum curve.

Stabilisation

OIS/VC helps camera shake only. A 2-stop default benefit is a photographic assumption, adjustable to your tested result. It is not a guarantee or body IBIS. No numeric rating is encoded except the XC15–45 (3 stops) and XC13–33 (4 stops) manufacturer claims.

Viltrox 27mm autofocus and aperture are verified in its official table. An explicit manufacturer OIS statement was not found there; no benefit is assumed.

Estimates, not measurements

Light descriptions have roughly ±1–2 stop ranges. Shutter and depth choices are heuristics. Actual subject distance, lens transmission, macro light loss and flash power are not calculated. Take a test photograph and inspect focus and highlights.
